detail.title: Stoichiometric and Thermodynamic Constraints in Non-Equilibrium Chemical Persistence
detail.summary: Revised analysis confirms that irreducible autocatalytic subnetworks, characterized by algebraic conditions on stoichiometric submatrices, provide the necessary structure for chemical systems to maintain history-dependent states, distinguishing them from simple hysteresis.
detail.reason: Revising the notebook to integrate new stoichiometric findings and differentiate memory mechanisms.
